exposure: elevated estradiol levels on trigger day
elevated progesterone levels on trigger day
cohort: The study included infertile patients with a documented history of TB who underwent in vitro fertilization and embryo transfer (IVF-ET).
finding: Elevated estradiol levels (>= 5000 pg/ml) on the day of hCG trigger and twin pregnancies were identified as independent risk factors for recurrent TB among pregnant patients with a history of TB who undergo embryo transfer.
